content: Virtue is its own supreme and eternal reward.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Ipsa quidem virtus sibimet pulcherrima merces — Silius Italicus & Stoic Precepts
explanation: If you practice honesty only so people trust you with money, or practice kindness only to win votes, your virtue is merely commercial barter. True virtue carries its own divine payout: a quiet mind, a clear conscience, and a soul aligned with the cosmos.
practicalInsight: Act with absolute righteousness today, and demand zero applause, zero credit, and zero payback. The virtue itself is your reward.
reflectionPrompt: Are you treating virtue as a commercial currency to buy approval, or as the intrinsic health of your soul?
